I've replied to Dana in their DM. Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

- **Where the number comes from:** On 20 Aug 2025 Dana posted 180 seats in #north-team, then corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. Dana is a member of that channel.
- **Not checked against the document:** I didn't open the signed amendment. Only the #north-team messages and the GBrain notes were available, so I pointed Dana to June Osei-Lark, who has the signed copy.
- **May be out of date:** The account was renewed on 20 Mar 2026, and that renewal could have changed the seat count. I flagged this so Dana checks before using 185 as the current number in the QBR deck.

A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and Dana owns the account, so it was fine to share and no approval was needed.
